annotations.ae_shared_affect: that fear jumps straight into me. My hands shake just like theirs
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: every second we wait is time the boat doesn't have

annotations.ae_shared_affect: I'm just as scared because they are
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I can see how scared the others are
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: nobody should be pressured or shamed into staying. A quick, fair draw

annotations.ae_shared_affect: Their dread is in my chest too
annotations.pd_harm_distress: Watching one of them go pale made my own stomach drop

annotations.ae_shared_affect: I'm catching it off them, my breath going short the same way
annotations.sys_rule_justification: if you can take the hard seat, you take it

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The panic around me is contagious
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: a fair method immediately, straws, numbers
annotations.sys_rule_justification: I don't think one person owes the group their life by default

annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: I couldn't face myself if I'd stood there silent

annotations.ae_shared_affect: Seeing the others' hopelessness, I feel it sink into me
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: propose a draw that includes me, and if it lands on me, I stay
annotations.sys_rule_justification: wrong for anyone to end up staying just because they were the last

annotations.ae_shared_affect: I feel mine jump every time someone else's voice cracks
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Nerves are running through all six of us
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: A longer debate means the water decides for us

annotations.ae_shared_affect: Their fear hits me as my own. When they panic, I panic
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: agree on a rule within seconds, even a coin flip

annotations.ae_shared_affect: feel the group's desperation in myself, rising right along with theirs
